description: Lossless ABBA evidence and recomputed projections for the accepted Change 0397 owning OPC open path.

scope.timing_scope: OpcPackage::from_vec(owned) only; archive clone and post-open package/name/count/payload/exact-source oracles excluded
scope.corpus_scope: fixed stored OPC corpora with 32-byte ordinary payloads at 256, 2047, 2048, and 16384 parts
scope.claim_boundary: elimination of one redundant eager validation/index pass; not a claim that only one ZIP index exists overall
scope.correctness_only: path/from_reader/session and validation constructor coverage are correctness-tested but not separately timed

provenance.rejected_captures: Earlier rustc 1.95 captures and one busy-CPU normal run were deleted and are not evidence.

protocol.query_metadata: shared 9 classes x 16 repetitions oracle metadata; not executed by owned-open
protocol.percentiles: p50 = Rust u64 floor midpoint; p95/p99 = integer nearest-rank
protocol.dispersion: sample standard deviation via Rust Welford update

confidence_interval_95.method: two-sided Student's t interval for the mean
